title: Report to the Honorable Steven H. Schiff, House of Representatives: Government Records, Results of a Search for Records Concerning the 1947 Crash Near Roswell, New Mexico, July 28, 1995
doc_notes: This document is a 1995 GAO report detailing the results of an extensive search for government records concerning the 1947 Roswell crash, concluding that no evidence of an extraterrestrial event was found and that records were largely destroyed or non-existent.

incidents.summary: Recovery of a crashed object near Roswell, New Mexico, initially reported as a flying disc and later identified as a radar-tracking balloon.
incidents.explanation: Identified by military officials as a radar-tracking balloon, later associated with Project Mogul.
incidents.quote: The object turned out to be a radar tracking balloon.
incidents.size: balloon approximately twenty feet in diameter
